name: ft-location-denied-toast
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 3): the permission-DENIED path - the honest denial toast (quick-filters.tsx:180-209). A FRESH member with NO profile location is registered through the REAL register door (city and state left empty - every seeded persona carries a TX location, so a fresh no-location account is the only honest way to reach the unknown-region state). The feed's Filters sheet must render the ask row; a REAL click on 'Use my device location' meets the headless browser's denial; the honest toast renders verbatim; NO grant is persisted.

steps.name: honest-derivation-null-for-loopback
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/location-context', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 80) })()

steps.text: We don't know roughly where you are yet
You can try again any time, or add a city and state to your profile.

steps.name: no-grant-persisted
steps.expr: (() => { const raw = localStorage.getItem('ft_location_context'); if (!raw) return 'grantPersisted=false blob=absent'; const p = JSON.parse(raw); return 'grantPersisted=' + (p.precise ? 'TRUE' : 'false') + ' blob=present coarse=' + p.coarseRegion })()
